messages:
Mike Chen: can we lock a private/VPC change window for NovusHealth (on‑prem) next Tue? customer prefers late evening. proposing 2026-03-24 23:00-02:00 UTC. purpose: runtime patch + model rollout + minor DB migration. need owners for rollout, smoke, rollback ready.
Priya Patel: I can own the rollout + orchestration. will need DB migration script approval and a quick dry-run.
Elena Gomez: I’ll own smoke tests and post-rollout validation. will prepare a short checklist.
Samir Kapoor: infra pre-checks from me: node health, disk space, networking path to customer VPC. I’ll cordon nodes 15m before and uncordon after success.
Jonas Li: QA available for integration smoke at +30m after rollout start. please give me expected endpoints and test creds.
Rachel Park: NovusHealth confirms the slot but asks for a 30m heads-up before we start. escalation contact is @marcus_novus (phone on file).
deploy-bot: scheduled window created: NovusHealth_patch_1750001234. Reminder 24h and 1h before.
Mike Chen: quick list of must-haves before we start: 1) DB snapshot + backup verified 2) KMS rotation disabled for the key in use 3) rollback playbook staged in runbook repo 4) smoke checklist committed.
Priya Patel: DB snapshot queued. linking PR for migration script: https://git.redwood/infra/migrations/pulls/42
Elena Gomez: smoke checklist draft (examples):
```
- curl health endpoint /_status (200)
- run ./tools/smoke_check --model Novus-main
- sample request/response validation (embedding sanity)
- check 95p latency < 300ms for sync route
- confirm KV cache warm-up complete
```
Samir Kapoor: rollback commands (kept simple):
- scale rollout group back to previous image: `redwoodctl rollout revert --id <rollout-id>`
- restore DB from snapshot if migration fails: `pg_restore --dbname=...`
I’ll keep SSH access and console shortcuts ready.
Jonas Li: I’ll run smoke runbook and post a short log snippet in thread within 30m of start.
Rachel Park: customer asked for a dry-run on their staging first — can we schedule a 30m rehearsal on Fri?
Priya Patel: yes we can do Fri 21:00 UTC rehearsal. I'll push rehearsal checklist and invite Novus staging contact.
oncall: pinging infra-oncall for the window: @oncall — can you standby for the Tue slot?
oncall: oncall here, I’ll be on standby. can take pager for the window.
Mike Chen: thanks — final ask: if no objections, I’ll lock the window today at 16:00 PDT. last call for changes. :thumbsup:
Elena Gomez: ack from smoke side. I’ll post the finalized checklist by EOD.
Samir Kapoor: ack from infra. pre-check runbook updated.
Jonas Li: ack from QA.
Priya Patel: ack, I’ll post the playbook link and PR updates once CI passes.
Mike Chen: locking window in 15m unless someone objects. I’ll post a summary to #customer-deploys and ping Novus contact.
